name: Pung
description: Pung, the open instrument platform: open instruments, audio effects and MIDI generators on Push 3 as devices in Live, in Push's browser and device view, each with a designed interface on the Push screen. It plays modules in the Schwung format (which began on Ableton Move) and modules of its own, on Push Hack's Live device layer (core/livedevice). Needs Push Manager's VST3 scan switched on.
author: rgeissen
